title.zh: 通往 E3 之路 · 第 5 天

subtitle.en: The final day: more small fixes than expected, but the build is in good shape for E3.
subtitle.zh: 最后一天：要修的小东西比预想的多，但整体状态已经能拿去 E3 见人了。

translator.note: 原文 1 张图；图片链接指向原文上传的最大尺寸原图。

blocks.en: Final day and a lot more little things to polish than I expected. Every time I got something fixed another problem would pop up.
blocks.zh: 最后一天，要打磨的小东西比我预想的多得多。每次我修好一个，就会冒出另一个问题。

blocks.en: We got everything in a good state for E3 but there are quite a few more ideas we want to try for the castle visuals, probably 2 or 3 more days of work.
blocks.zh: 我们把一切都收拾到了可以给 E3 用的状态，但城堡的视觉效果还有不少想法想试，大概还得再花两三天。
